description: v1's merge-under-fire in clash form (SPEC §5.6, §15.7): three player Capguards, too far apart to knit in the muster, close on an enemy Amanita Knight while an enemy Gill Archer shoots them. They deal or take damage every second, so they never go 2 s out of combat and never knit (merges stay 0 through tick 200).
